A dollar total belongs in 'undefined_24' (page 2: 'If this is the last page of your form, add the dollar value totals from all pages'); the page subtotals 'undefined_9' (p1) and 'undefined_23' (p2) are also unbound. _emit() writes '0.00' (only None/'' are skipped), so every filing puts a number on a Part 2 page the form says not to submit when unused. Value is also near-always 0.00 because of known DIG-26.
